caption: The drawing features a single large ceramic jug set within a rectangular border. The jug has a rounded, elongated body that narrows toward the top and a single curved handle connecting the short neck to the upper shoulder of the vessel. Its surface is textured and mottled in earth-toned colors, predominantly light brown and sandy gray, giving a natural, slightly aged appearance. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small rectangular inset containing a decorative motif: a stylized eight-petaled flower drawn in shades of gray and labeled with the text "J. FENTON" at the top. The artist’s signature, "C. GARVAN," appears at the lower left corner below the rectangular border. The background of the entire drawing is a light beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
